_note: LONG2 K1 (S565, Kalli SQ339 design 1, her pick) - THE WAITING CROSS and THE JAB THAT MEETS HIM. The page already lets a cross thrown at Long land on a man who steps in during that very moment (the step is played first, the men are at Mid when the glove arrives) and makes a cross at a man who did not come fall short and hand him counters. K1 adds her two bonuses: that cross is a counter (+1: 4 health) because he walked onto it, and a jab or body jab that lands on a man in the moment he steps in from Long scores 2 points, as a big punch does.

lands${openNow[sh.k] ? ' as a counter' : onto ? (v ? ' as a counter - he walked onto it stepping in' : ' as a counter - you walked onto it stepping in') : ''}
${(a.d >= 3 || (walked && (sh.id === 'jab' || sh.id === 'bjab'))) ? '2 points' : '1 point'}${walked && a.d < 3 && (sh.id === 'jab' || sh.id === 'bjab') ? ' (it caught him stepping in)' : ''}
